lines.zh: 我高瘦的影子拉得很长
lines.en: My long thin shadow stretches out.
I move on the balls of my feet.
My lanky frame sways as I walk.
I float up and settle back down.
I round the stone pillar.
My steps make no sound.
I slip through the doorway sideways.
My cape trails behind me.
I walk with my head tilted.
A little dust lifts under my feet.
I close in on you slowly.
I walk with hands at my hips.
I cock my long head.
I stick out my tongue and lick.
My long fingers flick.
I dangle my legs in the air.
I fold my arms and grin.
I crack my neck.
I stare at you a long while.
My shoulders bob up and down.
I gather my cape around me.
I count the energy on you.
My toe traces a circle.
I go abruptly silent.
I bare a row of teeth.
I yawn wide.
I bend down to look at you.
So small. How amusing.
I circle once around you.
I lean in and sniff you.
Your energy smells sweet.
I lick my lips.
I tilt my head at your fists.
Go on, try me.
I grin until my eyes narrow.
I point a long thin finger at you.
This body is much taller than you.
You look like a snack from here.
The corner of my mouth curls.
I am not afraid of what you hold.
You retreat; I lean closer.

lines.zh: 我抬手比了比你的个头
lines.en: I measure your height with a hand.

lines.zh: 你身上有股好闻的味道
lines.en: You have a pleasant smell.
Let us play a while.
Ugh, how annoying.
I tip sideways and retreat.
That hurt me.
My grin freezes.
A mark shows on my skin.
I shake my thin shoulders.
My blood is purple. How ugly.
I will remember that one.
I rub where it struck.
I cannot laugh anymore.
What are you holding up?
Is that edible?
I reach out for it.
Sweet? Let me taste.
I lean in and sniff.
Feed me and I may spare you.
I fix my head sideways on it.
That is not nearly enough.
I open my mouth wide.
You taste it first.
You hit me like hitting cotton.
I bounce lightly aside.
You stepped on my cape.
The bump tips me sideways.
I push you away with a hand.
My body gives like rubber.
You slip past my leg.
The knock makes me laugh.
I spin once and steady.
Bumping me will not help you.
She drifts up beside me.
We tilt our heads in unison.
She tugs my cape.
I draw her to my side.
We bare our teeth together.
She is a little shorter than I.
We both look at you at once.
She copies the way I tilt my neck.
We float up shoulder to shoulder.
Neither of us speaks.
I bend and pick up the stone.
I crush it into a candy lump.
I'll roll it into candy and pocket it.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂就不感兴趣了
lines.en: I weigh it, then lose interest.
I toss it up and catch it.
I stuff it into my cape.
I pick it up and sniff.
I swallow it whole.
I spit it out with a noise.
I toss it away.
My grin fades.
I straighten my tilted head.
Now I stop being gentle.
I knead a ball of ki in my palm.

lines.zh: 你身上有我想要的东西
lines.en: You have something I want.
My eyes go suddenly fixed.
I throw my cape back.
Let me offer you a sweet.
Do not run; it will not help.
I hold up two fingers.
I want to hear you scream.
This body has waited too long.

lines.zh: 粉色的一团，浮到你头顶。
lines.en: A pink blob floats up over your head.
You first, or shall I?
I clench my fist until it pops.
Enough laughing; time to work.
I hover right at your back.
When your hand lifts, I vanish.
I leave an afterimage behind.
A ki ball circles your feet.
I am counting when you tire.
Your moves bore me.
I hover at your flank.
Stop watching my back.
I hang a hand above your shoulder.
You turn too slowly.
Every sweet is waiting for you.
I grin without a sound.
I come at three.
You have backed to the corner.
I sink to your height.
At this distance I can reach you.
Your breathing has no rhythm.
I am beginning to get bored.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸在你身旁的地上
lines.en: My fist slams the ground beside you.
My Majin fist bursts the dust.
My foot catches your chest.
I flick out a small ki blast.
A rapid volley gives you no breath.

lines.zh: 我闪过你的攻击，回身就笑
lines.en: I dodge your swing and laugh.
My arm sweeps you away.

lines.zh: 空中连击把你打到墙里
lines.en: An air combo slams you into the wall.

lines.zh: 我贴近你的耳朵吹了口气
lines.en: I lean to your ear and breathe.
This one I shape into candy.
He flies a long way.

lines.zh: 我踩着他的胸口落下来
lines.en: I land with a foot on his chest.
I swing a backhand.
My punch's wind bends his weapon.
I land three blows in a row.
I am laughing happily.
I come down slowly from the air.
I pop out with my head cocked.
My cape lifts a puff of dust.
I laugh once first.
This place smells good.
My shadow is thin and long.

lines.zh: 我从门后探出半个身子
lines.en: I lean half out from the doorway.
I stretch my lanky body.
What are you all playing?
I put both hands behind me.
Shallow prints are left on the ground.
I draw my soft waist straight.
I came looking for fun.
A sweetness enters the air.

lines.zh: 我落地时一点声音都没有
lines.en: I land without a sound.
Everyone stops moving.
I look left and right.
I am starting to feel hungry.
Fire puckers my skin.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，斗篷盖住了头
lines.en: I fall and my cape covers my head.
Water gets into my throat.
The blast rolls me away.
Something lodges in my arm.
A charm clings to my body.
Hunger keeps me from standing straight.
Lightning strikes and I smoke.
My body is dragged down.
